answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The lotus of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
